Comment 10408 (2026-07-28) lists the delivered bridge (proof URL fields, attached checkboxes, Proof Status) and says the remaining Proof Files object + upload component + storage service is ~36h; comment 10409 (2026-07-29) says the storage build is gated on client GCP prerequisites. JQL run: project = WAGR AND (text ~ storage OR text ~ GCP OR Epic Link/parent = WAGR-31); project = WAGR AND (text ~ proof OR text ~ upload) AND statusCategory != Done.
corrections: suggested_action is wrong that 'no open ticket holds the post-POC storage build': WAGR-112, WAGR-113, WAGR-114, WAGR-360, WAGR-362 are open under the Sign-Up Proofs & Storage epic (WAGR-31).
